**Finding submitted: missing (TRANSITION).**

- **Investigation:** Section 10 (effect of expiry/termination) only ends Service access "after any agreed transition period," delivers paid-for Deliverables and refunds prepaid Fees. Section 16.5 covers return/destruction of Confidential Information but expressly defers Customer Data to Sections 11 and 15; Section 15 contains only processing-restriction and privacy terms, and Sections 11 and 23 carry no operative text. Searches for transition/export/deletion/machine-readable returned nothing responsive.
- **Classification:** No usable clause exists, so the agreement fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance; 30-day export).
- **Cure:** One insertion of a new §10.3 after p0042 carrying exactly the six preferred elements — up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter — with the 90-day fallback offered in the comment.
